source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: A Healer's Mercy (All Wounded Thieves Location)
source_excerpt:
Yu'er is one of the most likable characters you'll have a chance to meet again at the Crimson Forest Thieves' Den and start a quest called A Healer's Mercy in Phantom Blade Zero . The Silver-Tongue Thief, alongside her, will require players to help the wounded thieves across the Crimson Forest by getting them Yu'er Life-Saving Pill. To help you complete the quest, here are all the locations of the wounded thieves in Phantom Blade Zero A Healer's Mercy quest.
How to Start A Healer's Mercy in Phantom Blade Zero
After normally progressing through the Crimson Forest, players will eventually end up at the Thieves' Den quite early on in the region. Here, you'll first need to activate the Crane Bell and get another glimpse into Soul's story. Once you're done, Yu'er and the Silver-Tongue Thief will spawn in front of the hut beside the bell.
Talk to Yu'er and make sure to select the "The Wounded in the Wood" dialog to start A Healer's Mercy quest in Phantom Blade Zero . Players will also receive the "Yu'er Life-Saving Pill" story item that they'll need to bring to four wounded thieves scattered around the Crimson Forest region.
You'll also pick up the "Secrets of Baishan Sect" quest before arriving at the Thieves' Camp, and it's recommended to complete that first so you can open up the Crimson Forest region up to the mountain lodge.
All Wounded Thieves Locations in Phantom Blade Zero A Healer's Mercy Quest
There are four wounded thieves scattered around the Crimson Forest region that you'll need to get Yu'er Life-Saving Pill too in the Phantom Blade Zero Healer's A Mercy quest.
To find the first wounded thief, start by fast traveling to the "Outlaw's Trap" bell in the early area of the Crimson Forest region. Once you've spawned in, turn right and head through the cave.
At the mouth of the cave, you'll find a wounded thief lying on the ground that you can save by handing him Yu'er Life-Saving Pill.
In case you haven't, make sure to pick up the Crimson Forest Tunnel Crank inside the cave as well, as you'll need it to reach the second wounded thief.
Now, return to the Outlaw's Trap bell again and head down through the Crimson Forest Tunnel that you might have opened with the crank found in the cave. Once you drop down, head right, across the wooden bridge .
Keep going, and you'll eventually stumble upon the second wounded thief that you can save by handing him Yu'er's Life-Saving Pill.
Now, fast travel to the "Cliffside Lodge" bell , and you'll arrive at the Mountain Lodge where you saved junior sister Meng from.
Look to the left of the ledge, and you'll find a ladder heading to the lower platform . Head down, and you'll find the third wounded thief for A Healer's Mercy quest in Phantom Blade Zero .
To find the last wounded thief, you'll need the "Thieves Camp Dungeon" Key that you'll find while completing the Secrets of Baishan Sect quest. Now travel to the "Thieves' Camp" bell and follow the path heading down a cavern to the locked door.
Open the door to the Thieves' Camp Dungeon, and you'll find the last wounded thief right in front of you.
Once you've saved all four wounded thieves, return to Yu'er at the Thieves' Camp, and she'll give you the "Calming Gourd" Accessory as a reward for completing A Healer's Mercy in Phantom Blade Zero .
